gamerule.sscKeepFormAfterDeath.descripti: When enabled, players retain their current form after respawning. Enabled by default
screen.sscfe.form_powers.title: Form Abilities
screen.sscfe.form_powers.close: Press the key or Esc to close
screen.sscfe.form_powers.oxygen_health.d:
Max health changes by oxygen level:
≥270: +6 HP (+3 hearts)
240–269: +4 HP (+2 hearts)
210–239: +2 HP (+1 heart)
180–209: 0
150–179: 0
120–149: 0
90–119: -4 HP (-2 hearts)
60–89: -6 HP (-3 hearts)
30–59: -8 HP (-4 hearts)
<30: -10 HP (-5 hearts)
power.shape-shifter-curse.form_axolotl_3: While standing on a block and sprinting, press Active Skill 1 to dash forward, damage nearby creatures, and consume 20 air. Cooldown: 3 seconds.
power.shape-shifter-curse.form_axolotl_2: When the water height is at least one block, press Sprint to dash forward. Cooldown: 5 seconds.
power.shape-shifter-curse.jump_out_water: Press Jump near the water's surface to leap upward. Cooldown: 0.5 seconds.
power.shape-shifter-curse.form_axolotl_3: Hide Arms While Sneaking or Swimming
Your arms are hidden in first person while sneaking or swimming.
Greatly increases how long you can breathe underwater.
When the conditions are met, ground friction increases by 0.35.
item.sscfe.water_curse.controls: Axolotl charm: Shift + right-click changes mode; right-click toggles or selects Purple variant. Click V to cast, again to cancel
item.sscfe.water_curse.costs: Water combat/shield: 1 moisture per hit. Full Purple: 32 B + 50% max moisture; interrupted casts cost nothing
item.sscfe.water_curse.creative: Creative: use in any form, held or equipped; no resource costs, cooldown or stance requirements
message.sscfe.water_curse.resources: Not enough tank water or moisture for this Water Purple cast
message.sscfe.water_curse.busy: Too many active Water Purple beams; cast cancelled without payment
message.sscfe.water_curse.chunk_missing: Water Purple reached ungenerated terrain; flight stopped and reached terrain is being cleaned up
message.sscfe.water_curse.chunk_load_fai: Chunk read failed; Water Purple stopped and released its loading tickets
message.sscfe.water_curse.chunk_wait_tim: Chunk loading timed out; Water Purple stopped and released its loading tickets
hud.sscfe.water_purple: Water Purple: %ss · Locked · V to cancel
tooltip.sscfe.water_storage.fill: Hold a water/empty bucket in the other hand; right-click in air to fill/drain
item.sscfe.moisturizer.tooltip: Axolotl form, belt: refills in water; uses 2 mB/s on land to preserve moisture
item.sscfe.large_water_tank.tooltip: Axolotl form, back: -10% movement speed; supplies the moisturizer. Place to connect fluid pipes
item.sscfe.water_as_food.tooltip: Axolotl form, charm: when hungry, spend 1 moisture each second for 1 hunger and 1 saturation
jei.sscfe.moondust_armor_repair: Morphscale and Netherite Morphscale armor can be repaired with Untreated Moondust in an anvil. Each piece of moondust restores up to one quarter of maximum durability, preserves enchantments, and costs experience under normal anvil rules. Original repair materials still work.
jei.sscfe.moon_adaptation: Shapelessly craft one book, one Morphscale Core, and seven Untreated Moondust into a Moon Adaptation enchanted book. Apply it to armor or elytra in an anvil to bypass form equipment restrictions and allow repairs with Untreated Moondust. Each moondust repairs up to one quarter of maximum durability. Maximum level: I. Compatible with existing enchantments.
jei.sscfe.edible_moondust: Craft five with XYX / YXY / XYX, where X is any food and Y is Untreated Moondust. All forms can eat it regardless of instinctive dietary restrictions. Each serving restores 3 hunger and 3 saturation.
